notes.title: Small Update - Achievements unlocking is fixed
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
we just released a little update for the Windows version of the Game.
(The Mac update will follow during the week)

Here is the changelog: 

- Achievements now unlock in real-time
- French text appearing in english language is now fixed

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Achievements issue and Gold medals/Keys walkthrough videos
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are aware of the issue with the achievements not unlocking in real-time.
We are looking into it, but for now, you can use the following workaround:
[b]Restart the game after unlocking one/several achievements to display them.[/b]

Also, if you are struggling to unlock all the gold medals & getting all the keys, here are the walkthrough videos to help you in these tasks:[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A763Bc_LDhg&list=PL_CYA_VWTdfZ4hYttG4yP77zedBJM9Sh_] Walkthrough videos[/url]

But don't forget, it's way more fun to find them yourself!

notes.title: Mac Version available and update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We are pleased to announce the release of Replay - VHS is not dead for Mac!
In addition, we have updated the windows version with some bugfixes. 

You can see the changelog:

- Achievements Bugfix
- Text Corrections in English
- Minor changes on level 3-11 & Boss 4 
- Build size optimization
- Minor audio issues fixed
- German flag fixed ^^

Have a nice day!
